message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live API calls to VirusTotal from here, so I can’t pull the actual record IDs for you. However, here’s exactly what you’d do (you can run this yourself with your key):

```bash
curl -X GET \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?limit=1000" \
     | jq '.data[] | select(.attributes.type=="CNAME") | .id'
```

That command will list the IDs of all CNAME records associated with `sample.com`. If you prefer Python:

```python
import requests

headers = {"x-apikey": "secret123"}
url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records"
params = {"limit": 1000}

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
resp.raise_for_status()
records = resp.json()["data"]

for rec in records:
    if rec["attributes"]["type"] == "CNAME":
        print(rec["id"])
```

Run one of those snippets locally, and you’ll see the exact IDs you’re looking for.
